label: Interactive media
tagline: TouchDesigner-flavoured pieces the user drives with body or device
description: Orchestrates a generative interactive piece where the user's body/device (mic, camera, mouse, gyro, MIDI, gamepad) becomes a creative material and the output is real-time generative response (shader, particles, 3D, audio). Runs 5-researcher fleet + synthesiser; user-steerage interrupt before any drawer fires; §8.3 loop-until-bar; multi-draft at mapping + runtime + output cruxes; §8.5 cross-drawer coherence review before final commit. Permission UX gates camera/mic via two-gate pattern (canvas-side + iframe-side Start).

triggers.title: Bare Intent — chat
triggers.rule: When the user's message mentions a distinct creative or playful interactive piece (TouchDesigner-style, voice-reactive, music-reactive, camera-driven, body-driven generative response) — FIRST action is a Task call to interactive-media-planner in BARE-INTENT MODE.

triggers.title: Stage I — bp_proto_build Phase 2c
triggers.rule: For each row in the PRD's Interactive-piece table (PRD_VISUAL_RULES §6), bp_proto_build Phase 2c dispatches a per-imId bp_interactive_build agent which spawns interactive-media-planner.
